card.name: Disability wording and accessibility notices
card.fires_on: Words right after or inside phrases about people with disabilities, such as 'persons with', 'for the benefit of', 'students with', and accessibility notices about alternate formats. It also fires weakly on some mixing-instruction words.

modes.label: Disability phrasing
modes.description: The word with, people, special or disabled in phrases that name people with disabilities or impairments.
modes.example: Persons with<< disabilities>> having difficulty accessing this information should contact us

modes.label: Accessibility notices
modes.description: Words in notices offering alternate formats or TTY phone access.
modes.example: you can request alternate<< formats>> of this page on the Contact Us page

modes.label: Dosing preparation text
modes.description: Weaker hits on words in instructions about mixing contents in a cup or soft food.
modes.example: Mix the contents of<< the>> cup well by vigorous stirring.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward disability words such as disabilities, disability, wheelchair and handicap, including Chinese terms for disabled people.
card.plain: It lights up where text is about to mention disability or people with disabilities, as in accessibility notices.
